subject: Insurance
title: Insurance After World War II
description: A short lesson to help you apply Insurance After World War II.

hook.text: After WWII, governments across Europe created national insurance systems.

buildup.text: Britain's 1942 Beveridge Report proposed cradle-to-grave welfare. Insurance became a government responsibility.

discovery.text: The NHS launched in 1948 with free healthcare for all. Private and public insurance began their long coexistence.

climax.text: WWII split the world into two insurance models: government-run and market-driven. The debate has never been settled.

punchline.text: Europe chose government insurance. America chose the market.

quiz.question: What did the Beveridge Report propose?
